MANAGER SUBMITS → OWNER APPROVES: before the manager submits, the owner's approve is refused (409 PAYROLL_PERIOD_NOT_READY — an unsubmitted week used to be finalized); the manager submits; the owner approves with a fresh step-up; six payouts exist (a check and a cash for each)

CHECK + CASH: each check is numbered and issued; reusing a check number is refused (CHECK_NUMBER_IN_USE); each cash half is prepared from the safe, handed over and CONFIRMED by its technician in the Tech App (a repeat replays; another technician cannot confirm it — refused)
PAID / UNPAID: after the cash is confirmed the week shows the cash halves PAID ($240.00) and the issued, not yet cleared checks UNPAID ($240.00); paid + unpaid = payable ($480.00)

managers for the three phones: Max true, Bea true, Cal true

timeline.check: S0 seven gel tickets reach Service Done through the queue + Tech App (the checkouts the phones will take)

S1 the POS pairing code needs a fresh owner step-up (403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED without); with it the owner creates a SHARED code (front desk) and a PERSONAL code (manager) — single-use, 5 minutes, this branch, only the sha256 stored
S2 three managers sign in ON their phones (the session carries the payment device id) and open the branch

S2 the FRONT DESK phone registers with the shared code (signed by its own key — proof of possession) → ACTIVE at once, shared; the MANAGER phone with the personal code → ACTIVE, personal; the shared code used again on another phone → PAIRING_CODE_INVALID
S1 the CHECKOUT phone registers normally (signed, with its key) → PENDING; approval without a fresh step-up is refused (403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED); with it the owner approves → ACTIVE

S2 the owner (step-up) sets each phone's locations through POST devices/:id/branches; DB: three ACTIVE phones, each with its own ES256 key + fingerprint, the branch rows written, the front desk SHARED, the manager phone bound to Bea, the checkout phone bound to Cal

S3 three phones take three checkouts AT THE SAME TIME (558 ms for all three): each lock → proceed → intent → readiness → provider session → capture succeeds; each ticket is PAID with ONE approved Tap to Pay payment and ONE processor charge

S3 AMOUNTS ARE THE SERVER'S: the intent carries the ticket's remaining balance (no client amount sent), the processor is charged exactly that, the payment row records exactly that although each phone reported capturedAmountCents = 1; a client amount above the balance is refused
S3 ATTRIBUTION: each payment row names the signed-in employee (created_by_user_id) and the phone (device_id) — Max on the front desk phone, Bea on hers, Cal on the checkout phone
S4 the SAME ticket claimed from two phones at the same instant → exactly ONE claim wins; the other gets 409 CHECKOUT_ALREADY_CLAIMED (the friendly "being processed on another payment device")

timeline.info: race winner checkout released the claim → 201
S6 probe set-up on the manager phone: claim 201, proceed 201, intent 201 null, readiness 201 ready, signed cancel 201 canceled, release 201

timeline.check: S6 ALTERED BODY after signing → 403 DEVICE_KEY_MISMATCH (the same signed request, untouched, is accepted)
S6 REPLAYED NONCE → the first is accepted, the identical second 409 DEVICE_REQUEST_REPLAYED
S6 STALE TIMESTAMP (10 minutes old, validly signed) → 403 DEVICE_KEY_MISMATCH

S6 UNSIGNED requests from a keyed phone are refused: the claim and the intent with no proof → DEVICE_KEY_MISMATCH; the device header without a signature → DEVICE_KEY_MISMATCH; a stolen session signing with another key → DEVICE_KEY_MISMATCH

S6 an UNSIGNED capture result ("declined") and an UNSIGNED cancel for the phone's READY intent → DEVICE_KEY_MISMATCH; the intent stays ready (only the phone that holds the key reports on its own payment)

S6 a SECOND DEVICE registering the SAME public key is refused — signed with the copied private key (DEVICE_KEY_MISMATCH "already belongs to another device"), signed by another key, or unsigned — and no device row is created
S7 the owner revokes the checkout phone mid-day (403 STEP_UP_REQUIRED without a fresh step-up; with it → revoked, the reason kept)
S7 DB: every session opened on that phone is REVOKED and every refresh token of those sessions is revoked; the phone's old session is refused at once and its refresh token cannot mint a new one

S7 signed in again on the revoked phone, EVERY route it signs answers 403 DEVICE_REVOKED (capability, readiness, queue, ticket, claim, intent, heartbeat, re-register, history); an unsigned intent naming it is refused too (no claim — the claim itself needs the phone)
S7 the other two phones keep working (signed capability 200 on the front desk and the manager phone)

S5 SHARED phone, shift change: Max signs out (his old cookie is dead), Bea signs in on the SAME front desk phone (same device id + key) and takes a payment → PAID, attributed to BEA on the front desk phone

S5 PERSONAL phone: Max signs in on Bea's phone (sign-in itself is allowed) — the claim is refused 403 DEVICE_NOT_AUTHORIZED, the intent 409 CONFLICT (no claim), the heartbeat 403 DEVICE_NOT_AUTHORIZED; no payment is taken
S8 a DROPPED connection on the capture → the attempt is UNKNOWN ("verifying", recoverable), never declined; the ticket stays open, no payment row
